title: VP of Product Management

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: EFI's continuous product launches (EFI Pro 30h+ hybrid printer debut at ISA 2025, VUTEk M3h at FESPA 2025) and emphasis on 'durable Genuine EFI Inks' for outdoor applications positions Product Management as the critical strategic owner. This role drives product differentiation in a competitive wide-format printer market where complete solutions matter. Partnering with Tedlar would enable EFI to offer a validated overlaminate recommendation alongside their UV LED printer/ink systems, creating a premium 'total durability solution' that addresses customer pain points around outdoor longevity, UV protection, and graffiti resistance. This enhances EFI's competitive positioning against HP, Canon, and other printer manufacturers by providing customers with proven 12-20+ year outdoor performance—a tangible selling advantage that Product Management can leverage in go-to-market strategy, sales enablement materials, and customer demonstrations at their ISA/FESPA booth presence.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: [Name] owns EFI's product strategy, roadmap, and competitive positioning for their wide-format printer portfolio (VUTEk, EFI Pro series). This role defines how EFI differentiates against HP, Canon, and other printer manufacturers, develops go-to-market narratives around complete printing solutions, and determines which partner technologies get validated and recommended to EFI's customer base. They influence the customer success playbook used by EFI's 1,000+ support employees and shape sales enablement materials for the sign/graphics, vehicle wraps, and building applications markets. They report to senior leadership (likely Chief Product Officer or CRO Todd Zimmerman) and manage Product Managers who execute specific printer line strategies. This role owns product performance metrics, competitive win rates, and customer satisfaction scores tied to print output quality and durability claims.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: EFI's customers—sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, architectural graphics producers, and billboard companies—are the exact end-users who need protective overlaminates for outdoor durability. The most relevant Tedlar use cases for [Name]'s product strategy are: (1) Signs and graphics overlaminates that protect EFI's UV LED prints from fading, yellowing, and cracking for outdoor banners, billboards, and building wraps; (2) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics protection that extends the life of prints produced on EFI VUTEk equipment; (3) Architectural graphics overlaminates for building facades and long-term outdoor installations using EFI's superwide roll-to-roll printers. By recommending Tedlar as the validated overlaminate for EFI printer outputs, [Name] creates a complete solution that addresses customer warranty concerns, reduces premature graphic replacement costs, and differentiates EFI's value proposition from equipment-only competitors. This transforms EFI from a printer/ink vendor into a total durability solution provider.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] is measured on product differentiation metrics that drive competitive win rates in a crowded wide-format printer market where HP Latex, Canon Colorado, and other systems compete on similar technical specs. They own customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Scores that suffer when EFI customers experience outdoor graphic failures—even when the printer and ink performed correctly but the overlaminate failed. Their roadmap success depends on creating defensible competitive advantages that sales can articulate at ISA Sign Expo, FESPA, and in customer demonstrations. Tedlar solves [Name]'s core challenge: EFI currently markets 'long-lasting, durable outdoor prints' but lacks a validated protective film recommendation to complete that promise. When EFI customers face UV degradation, graffiti damage, or premature graphic replacement, it undermines confidence in the entire EFI print solution. By integrating Tedlar into EFI's solution portfolio, [Name] gains a tangible differentiator—proven extreme outdoor performance that competitors cannot match—plus case studies, technical validation data, and co-marketing content that strengthen EFI's premium positioning and support higher equipment price points.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: EFI just debuted the Pro 30h+ hybrid printer at ISA Sign Expo 2025 and showcased the VUTEk M3h at FESPA Global Print Expo 2025 (May 6-9 in Berlin). These recent product launches create an immediate opportunity: [Name] is actively refining go-to-market messaging, sales enablement materials, and customer demonstration workflows for these new systems. This is the ideal moment to position Tedlar as the recommended protective overlaminate for EFI's latest outdoor-focused printers. Additionally, EFI's continuous presence at ISA, FESPA, and PRINTING United means [Name] is constantly evaluating partnership opportunities that enhance booth demonstrations and customer success stories. The competitive pressure from HP, Canon, and other manufacturers launching their own outdoor printing solutions creates urgency for [Name] to establish differentiated value propositions before the next major trade show cycle.

personalization_hooks.hook: EFI's recent Pro 30h+ and VUTEk M3h launches emphasize outdoor durability claims, but EFI lacks a validated protective overlaminate recommendation to complete the solution
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open by acknowledging EFI's 'long-lasting outdoor graphics' positioning and the competitive challenge of differentiating against HP/Canon on print durability alone. Position Tedlar as the missing piece that transforms EFI's durability messaging from marketing claims into proven performance—enabling [Name] to offer customers a validated total solution with documented field performance data that competitors cannot match. Frame this as a product strategy advantage, not just a material specification.

personalization_hooks.hook: EFI's customer base—sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, architectural graphics producers—directly faces warranty claims and replacement costs when outdoor graphics fail prematurely due to UV damage, fading, or graffiti
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Connect Tedlar's graffiti resistance and UV protection directly to [Name]'s customer satisfaction and competitive positioning metrics. When EFI customers experience graphic failures, they often attribute the entire solution failure to EFI equipment even when the overlaminate was the weak link. Present Tedlar partnership as reducing customer churn, strengthening EFI's premium brand reputation, and creating customer success stories that [Name] can leverage in sales enablement and trade show demonstrations.

personalization_hooks.hook: EFI exhibits at ISA Sign Expo, FESPA Global Print Expo, and PRINTING United with booth demonstrations emphasizing complete outdoor printing solutions
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference [Name]'s upcoming trade show presence and suggest co-demonstration opportunities where EFI + Tedlar showcase validated outdoor performance testing, side-by-side durability comparisons, and complete workflow integration. Position this as enhancing booth ROI and sales team effectiveness by providing tangible competitive advantages that resonate with sign manufacturers and graphics producers evaluating equipment investments. Offer to support EFI's customer success team with technical training on protective film best practices.

recommended_approach: Lead with product differentiation and competitive positioning angle—frame Tedlar as solving [Name]'s strategic challenge of differentiating EFI printers in a crowded market. Avoid technical material specs in the opening; instead, focus on how validated overlaminate recommendations strengthen EFI's go-to-market narrative, support premium pricing, and create customer success stories that drive competitive win rates. Reference recent product launches (Pro 30h+, VUTEk M3h) to demonstrate awareness of [Name]'s current priorities and suggest alignment with their roadmap timing.
